title: Third prophecy; another summit
english: We treat Balaam’s [[third prophecy >> Bible:Numbers 23:25—24:9]]. Balak thinks only the place failed the curse and leads him to [[the summit of Peor >> Bible:Numbers 23:28]].
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC (Numbers).
After Homilia XVI; third oracle CLOSEOUT.
